editorial.blurb: A beloved Pilsen institution since 1994, Cafe Jumping Bean serves robust coffee, traditional Mexican pastries, and sandwiches in a cozy, art-filled space that punches well above its tiny footprint.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or off-peak hours to snag a seat—the cafe gets packed at lunch. Ask for modifications on sandwiches (less cream cheese is a common request) and try the matcha latte alongside savory items like the focaccia chicken sandwich.
